defects: The conclusion is disconnected from the hypothesis map f: it only asserts ∃ h : M →ₗ[R] N, Surjective (LocalizedModule.map S h), with no relation between h's localization and f (or any scalar multiple of f). The gold requires the lift to satisfy IsLocalizedModule.map S f g φ = s • ϕ for some s ∈ S, i.e. the constructed map must actually be (a unit multiple of) the given surjective map's localization.
